title: With the Right Representation, Classical Machine Learning Rivals Deep Models for Olfactory Mixture Similarity
abstract: arXiv:2611.19650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modeling olfactory mixtures remains a critical challenge in machine olfaction because the task requires reasoning over relationships between sets of odorants rather than over individual molecules in isolation. However, prior comparisons between deep and classical approaches also varied how the relationship between the two mixtures was represented, since the classical baselines primarily relied on weak representations that described each mixture independently and provided little direct signal about how the mixtures differed. In this work, we revisit classical learning using explicit symmetric comparison features on unordered pairs of mixtures, evaluating these representations with XGBoost and kernel ridge regression (KRR). We find that XGBoost with explicit comparison features achieves performance competitive with specialized deep mixture models on the main benchmark. translated_title: 有了正确的表示方法，经典机器学习在气味混合物相似度任务上可与深度模型媲美
translated_abstract: 气味混合物的建模是机器嗅觉领域的一项关键挑战，因为该任务需要对气味物质集合之间的关系进行推理，而非对单个分子进行孤立分析。然而，以往深度方法与经典方法之间的对比研究，同时也改变了两种混合物之间关系的表示方式，因为经典基线方法主要依赖较弱的表示，这些表示只是独立地描述每种混合物，几乎无法提供关于两种混合物如何产生差异的直接信号。在本工作中，我们利用无序混合物对上的显式对称比较特征重新审视经典学习方法，并使用XGBoost和核岭回归（KRR）对这些表示进行评估。我们发现，采用显式比较特征的XGBoost在主要基准测试上取得了与专用深度混合物模型相当的性能。消融实验表明，仅使用逐坐标的绝对差值便已...
tldr: 该研究表明，只要采用显式的对称比较特征来表示混合物对，经典机器学习方法（如XGBoost）在气味混合物相似度任务上的表现便可媲美专门的深度模型。
en_tdlr: This study shows that with explicit symmetric comparison features for mixture pairs, classical machine learning methods such as XGBoost can rival specialized deep models on olfactory mixture similarity tasks.
